lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, circular local maxima arranged in approximately 10 vertical columns posterior to the gills. The central columns exhibit 4 to 5 distinct high-luminance centroids with regularized vertical spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs. The blobs are centrally positioned within these vertical stripes, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the visible lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance (superior) to shadow (inferior) along the longitudinal axis.
